response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The ratio rental_rate / rental_duration is computed per film and then averaged. The NULL original_language_id group is kept as its own group, since GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group. Ties in film count are not broken, because the request gives no tie-break.
